name: Lucid Trading
legal_entity_and_hq: Legal entity not named on the site; footer lists 3500 S Dupont Hwy, Dover, DE 19901, USA
instruments: CME Group futures (simulated); data via CQG (Tradovate/NinjaTrader/TradingView) or Rithmic

programs.name: LucidFlex (Evaluation -> LucidFlex Funded)
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing (trails highest closing balance); locks at $50,100 once the $52,100 initial trail balance is reached or a payout is requested
programs.consistency_rule: Evaluation: 40% (50% as a paid add-on). Funded: none.
programs.payout_frequency: Any day after 5 days of $150+ profit since the last payout (count resets after each approved payout)
programs.payout_rules_note: 50K: minimum $500; maximum 50% of profit, capped at $2,000 per request (cap does not increase); cycle must be net positive; no buffer required. Up to 5 payouts per account, after which the account is moved to live. Funded scaling: 2 minis ($0-$999 profit), 3 ($1,000-$1,999), 4 ($2,000+).
programs.notes: Daily loss limit is optional, chosen at purchase (DLL On = lower price, DLL Off = higher price); amount for 50K not stated. Price shown is the store's single listed price for 'LucidFlex 50K' (same on Tradovate/NinjaTrader and Rithmic); the store does not label it DLL On or Off. The 50% consistency option is a paid add-on at checkout, so the listed price is the standard 40% version.

programs.name: LucidPro (Evaluation -> LucidPro Funded)
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing; locks at $50,100 once the $52,100 initial trail balance is reached
programs.consistency_rule: Funded: largest day must be under 40% of total profit in the payout cycle (35% for accounts bought/reset before Nov 28, 2025); evaluation consistency not stated
programs.profit_split: 90/10 (accounts bought/reset before Nov 28, 2025 keep 100% of the first $10K)
programs.payout_frequency: Any day once eligibility is met (at least $500 profit earned since the last payout and 40% consistency)
programs.payout_rules_note: 50K: minimum request $500; maximum $2,000 for payout 1 and $2,500 from payout 2; $52,100 buffer balance that cannot be withdrawn. Funded accounts have full contract size immediately (no scaling plan). Payout 5 is the maximum payout level before live review.
programs.notes: DLL ($1,200 fixed on 50K; in funded, replaced by 60% of peak EOD profit once above $52,100) is a soft breach. A later customization article says the DLL can be turned On or Off at purchase (Off costs more); the store lists one price per size. The DLL figure applies when DLL is On.

news_trading: Allowed on LucidFlex, LucidPro and LucidDirect; restricted on LucidDaily (trading red-folder news is a hard breach)
ea_bots_allowed: Allowed: automated trading systems and trade copiers are permitted, must follow Lucid rules; high-frequency trading and microscalping are prohibited
copy_trading: Allowed: trade copiers are permitted (Other Trading Activities article)
overnight_weekend_holding: Not allowed: all positions must be closed by 4:45 PM ET Monday-Friday; open positions are auto-closed at 4:45 PM ET (does not fail the account)
restricted_countries_note: About 80 countries/regions restricted, including Serbia, Bosnia & Herzegovina, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Lithuania, Turkey, Russia, Ukraine, Philippines and Vietnam. US is not restricted. List: https://support.lucidtrading.com/en/articles/11404636-restricted-countries
payout_methods: WorkMarket by ADP (bank transfer or PayPal, US and international)
Crypto (BTC, ETH, LTC, USDT, USDC; international)
path_to_live: Traders enter the live review pool after the final (5th) payout on Flex/Pro/Direct, or via other triggers (large lifetime payouts, LucidDaily max daily profit); moves are at Lucid's discretion. Live accounts start at $0 with daily payouts, EOD drawdown ($2,000 on 50K), no DLL and no consistency rule; a cash-out option equals 50% of the live starting balance (90/10).

affiliate_program.notes: Applications closed; Lucid recruits partners directly.

recent_changes_2026.change: Daily loss limit made optional (On/Off at purchase) on LucidFlex, LucidPro and LucidDaily; DLL Off costs more.
New live structure: one live account per funded account with a payout, starting at $0 with daily payouts, plus a cash-out option.
LucidFlex evaluation consistency is 40% as standard; 50% is now a paid add-on

pros: One-time fee and no funded activation fee.
No consistency rule on LucidFlex funded accounts and no buffer requirement.
Automated systems and trade copiers are explicitly permitted.
Wide platform support across CQG and Rithmic.
cons: LucidFlex payout cap of $2,000 per request on 50K, and accounts are limited to 5 payouts before moving to live.
Legal entity is not named on the site; footer lists only a Dover, Delaware address.
Long restricted-country list (about 80), including Serbia and several Balkan/EU countries.
DLL pricing is not shown separately; the store lists one price per size.
best_for: Futures traders who want a low one-time evaluation fee, permission to use bots and trade copiers, and no consistency rule once funded (LucidFlex).
